name: Echo Grotto
mechanic: emit sonar pings to briefly paint a pitch-black cave in sound while lurking beasts home in on your echoes
theme: a blind bat feeling its way through five lightless caverns toward daylight
tagline: You were born blind. Sound is your sight.
controls: arrows / WASD or hold to glide, tap or space to ping

name: Muster!
mechanic: herd a flock by pressure - sheep flee the dog, so you push from behind and bark to scatter them, scare wolves or enrage the ram
theme: a sheepdog working five sunlit fields against the clock
tagline: The flock has opinions. You have a whistle.
controls: mouse / touch or WASD / arrows to run, space or B to bark

name: Perihelion Post
mechanic: drag to launch a mail pod along a live-predicted trajectory, planetary gravity slingshots the flight and scarce thruster burns correct course into the delivery ring
theme: a solo courier drone running eight alien star systems on gravity alone
tagline: Aim once. Let the planets do the rest.
controls: mouse / touch drag to aim & launch, WASD / arrows or hold to thrust, space recalls the pod

name: Orbit Post
mechanic: drag-release slingshot throws of a mail pod bent by planetary gravity into a drop ring, with a live trajectory forecast and orbiting moon hazards
theme: an interplanetary courier service running five delivery runs between planets and moons
tagline: Gravity does the flying. You just let go at the right moment.
controls: mouse / touch drag or arrows + space

name: Night Junction
mechanic: flip track levers in real time to steer colour-coded steam trains into their matching stations, juggling occupied platforms and rear-end collisions
theme: a lone signalman running a storm-lit mountain junction box with three lanterns and an unfinished east line
tagline: Every lever is a promise. Keep it.
controls: mouse / touch tap levers or keys 1-3, P pause, R restart, M sound

name: Shadow Stage
mechanic: drag translucent shadow puppets across a lantern-lit screen and resize them by pushing them toward the flame, assembling each fable's silhouette against a live likeness meter before the audience's patience runs out
theme: a travelling shadow-puppet theatre performing seven paper fables behind one guttering oil lamp
tagline: Closer to the flame, bolder the shadow.
controls: mouse / touch drag shadows & gold resize knob, scroll or -/+ to resize, arrows nudge, Tab cycles, Enter presents, R restarts, M sound

name: Static Watch
mechanic: sweep an analogue dial to hunt drifting radio carriers by a falling beat-tone whistle and magic-eye glow, then hold the needle inside the lock window to log each voice
theme: the night wireless watch aboard a 1962 North Sea trawler, pulling ghost voices out of storm static
tagline: Somewhere in the static, someone is calling.
controls: mouse / touch drag or click the dial, arrows sweep, up/down fine trim, M mute, P pause, R restart

name: Chartwright
mechanic: glimpse a fog-bound island for a few seconds, then redraw its coastline freehand from memory - your ink is scored by how much of the true landmass it captures
theme: a ship's cartographer in a fogbound archipelago, redrawing charts lost overboard before landfall
tagline: The chart went overboard. Redraw it before landfall.
controls: mouse / touch to draw, Z undo, C clear, Space commits

name: Live Wire
mechanic: hold and drag a live spark along glowing circuit traces, balancing on the copper through sweeping rotor arms, timed capacitor flares and patrolling solder bugs without drifting off the trace
theme: a spark of current restoring five failing boards of a darkened mainframe on three fuses
tagline: Steady hands carry the current.
controls: mouse / touch hold & drag, arrows or WASD nudge, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Anvil Song
mechanic: strike the hammer when a sweeping mark crosses the glowing zone while bellows-feeding heat and rationing one shared coal bed, then quench each blade true
theme: a storm-lit mountain smithy forging five blades over a single dying coal bed
tagline: Iron remembers every blow.
controls: space / enter or tap to strike, hold B or the bellows button to reheat, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Hot Metal
mechanic: type the word carried by each slug of loose type before it reaches the wet page; mistyped keys break your pay chain, red slugs run fast for double pay, gilded slugs lift a smudge when set
theme: a midnight hand-printing shop where the type case has spilled and the press never stops until the dawn bell
tagline: Catch the words before the ink sets.
controls: keyboard letters; on-screen keys on touch; backspace or escape drops a held slug; buttons pause, mute, restart

name: Bad Penny
mechanic: load equal numbers of suspect coins on a two-pan balance, read each tilt as evidence that one counterfeit runs heavy or light, and accuse it before your limited weighings are spent
theme: an assayer's chamber in the royal mint, testing suspect batches under the magistrate's three wax seals
tagline: Every batch hides one lying coin. The scales never lie.
controls: mouse / touch tap coins (left pan, right pan, back), or arrows + A/D/S to place, Enter weighs, E accuses then H/L swears heavy or light, C clear, M sound, R restart

name: Escapement
mechanic: drag spare gears onto brass pegs to mesh a weight-driven wheel into the clock's crown, each mesh reversing the turn while tooth sizes trade speed for reach, rusted dead gears blocking the road
theme: the night shift inside a stopped clocktower, rebuilding six stripped gear trains floor by floor before midnight
tagline: Every tooth must catch.
controls: mouse / touch tap-to-place or 1-3 pick up, arrows aim, enter drops / lifts, x unmeshes, R resets floor, M sound, P pause

name: Glass Plate
mechanic: pan and zoom a spirit camera across a haunted ballroom, framing flickering apparitions and timing the shutter for when each spirit burns brightest, spending twelve glass plates to fill a five-print album before dawn
theme: a midnight spirit-photography séance in a derelict manor house
tagline: Frame what flickers. Shoot while it burns.
controls: mouse / touch drag to pan, click / tap or Space shoots, scroll / pinch or + − zooms, R restarts, P pauses, M sound

name: Waggle Dance
mechanic: hold and steer a scout bee's waggle run on the vertical comb, encoding each flower patch's angle against the sun shaft and its distance as hold length while wind gusts shove you off-line, recruiting foragers that ferry nectar home to the comb
theme: a honeybee hive racing to seal six summer days of comb before winter settles over the meadow
tagline: Dance the map. The hive follows.
controls: hold space / touch-hold to waggle, arrows or drag to aim, release at the right ring, E eats honey, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Bone Bed
mechanic: switch between a reckless pick that bites fast but cracks buried bone and a patient brush that frees it clean, spending scarce probe pings to ghost the skeleton through the rock
theme: a lone palaeontologist opening a sun-baked badlands quarry before the storm season
tagline: The rock kept it for sixty million years. Free it gently.
controls: mouse / touch hold to dig, keys or tap 1 / 2 / 3 for pick, brush, probe, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Thin Ice
mechanic: skate tile-by-tile across a frozen pond where every crossing cracks the ice further, ferrying stranded skaters home in a rescue train whose growing weight breaks the ice faster
theme: a moonlit midwinter pond before dawn, skating out from a lamplit shore hut as cracks spread and holes slowly refreeze
tagline: The pond remembers every step.
controls: arrows / WASD to step, swipe or tap to skate, P pause, R restart, M sound

name: Midnight Broth
mechanic: drop the noodle basket into a live simmer ring, fill each ticket's topping slots while it cooks, then strain inside a shrinking green window before customer patience or the pot runs out
theme: a rain-slick midnight ramen yatai serving its last ten regulars before dawn
tagline: Ten hungry regulars. One pot of courage.
controls: mouse / touch taps or keys 1-5 toppings, space drops & strains, enter serves, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Night Haul
mechanic: hold to sink a net to the right depth and release to snap it shut around drifting schools that bolt from the ropes, while eels hug the mud, moonfish rise late and one old carp haunts the deep
theme: a lantern-lit rowboat on a still mountain lake, filling the creel before the dawn bell rings you home
tagline: Sink it slow. Close it quick.
controls: drag to row or arrows, hold Net button / space / down to sink, release to close, P pause, M sound, R new night

name: Firebreak
mechanic: dig bare-soil firebreak lines and set risky backburns to starve a wind-driven wildfire before it reaches the cabins, while the wandering night wind and ember throws jump thin lines
theme: a drought-stressed homestead valley held through five night shifts of rising, shifting wind
tagline: You cannot put it out. Take its lunch.
controls: mouse / touch drag to cut & tap to burn, arrows + space cursor, Z / X tools, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Foldsong
mechanic: fold a two-sided patterned sheet in half edge over edge, each crease flipping its layers plain-side-out, until the commissioned motif lies face-up - and the named motif hides just beneath - on the sealed packet
theme: a paper-folder's desk in a candlelit stationer's shop, working through six afternoon commissions
tagline: Every crease decides what shows.
controls: click / tap folded edges or arrow keys to fold, U undo, R restart order, P pause, M sound

name: Wick & Wing
mechanic: you never steer the moth - it always veers toward the nearest burning wick (and violet zappers burn brightest), so you snuff lanterns for free and relight them for scarce matches, chaining its flight through sleeping buds before dawn past brambles, crosswind gusts and a light-hunting bat
theme: a walled cottage garden across six nights of a fading moon, one matchbox between the moth and morning
tagline: You cannot fly. Choose what burns.
controls: mouse / touch tap lanterns or arrows + space, 1-9 direct, P pause, R restart, M sound

name: Going Once
mechanic: ration one purse across twelve lots under a falling hammer, outbidding three rivals whose visible quirks, ceilings and purses are the only appraisal you get
theme: a candlelit 1893 country auction house selling heirlooms of dubious provenance
tagline: Buy low before the hammer falls.
controls: mouse / touch buttons or space/B to bid, X to pass, P pause, R restart, M sound

name: Loop & Load
mechanic: program a looping command sequence that the depot bot repeats forever, threading it past shelves, oil slicks and patrol sweepers to grab each parcel, post it at the chute and roll onto the charge pad
theme: the last night shift of a parcel depot run by loop-fed courier robots
tagline: It only knows your loop. Make it a good one.
controls: mouse / touch tap commands and buttons, or keys F/L/R/W/G to program, Backspace erase, Enter or Space run/stop, R restart, P pause, M sound

name: Stitchwork
mechanic: fill each patch with the fabric it asks for to piece a quilt top, then sew every seam with its called-for thread colour before the oil lamp burns down - wrong thread snaps a needle
theme: a candlelit sewing room working five blocks of a winter commission
tagline: Every seam asks its own colour.
controls: mouse / touch tap or arrows + space, 1-6 fabrics, Q / E thread, Z undo, R redo block, P pause, M sound

name: Brakefall
mechanic: hold to brake a runaway ore cart while brake heat fades the shoes, crawling posted hairpins and rotten trestles, outrunning the collapse dust to bank the load at the flooded sump
theme: the last working gangway of a lamplit copper mine, five switchback flights above a flooded sump
tagline: Gravity is the engine. The brake is the whole job.
controls: hold space / mouse / touch to brake, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Exact Change
mechanic: count exact change out of the till coin by coin before each customer's patience drains, chasing speed tips, streak bonuses and fewest-coin regulars through a rush minute
theme: a sun-bright harbour sweet shop on its record Saturday
tagline: Every penny counted. Every mood kept.
controls: mouse / touch tap coins or keys 1-9, 0, Backspace undo, C clear, Enter hands over, P pause, M sound, R new day

name: Poise
mechanic: hang carved weights anywhere along a mobile's arms so every rod settles level at once, reading each arm's tip arrow before you commit
theme: a lamplit sculptor's studio finishing five kinetic mobiles before the gallery opens at dawn
tagline: Everything hangs in the balance.
controls: mouse / touch drag or arrows + space to lift, slide & drop, Esc returns a carving, P pause, R restart piece, M sound

name: Tin Parade
mechanic: pump four wind-up muscles - paired hip strings and knee strings - to keep a ragdoll tin soldier balanced mid-stride as he marches down the shelf
theme: a moonlit toyshop shelf where a forgotten wind-up soldier tries to ring the till bell before opening time
tagline: Hips swing, knees snap. Don't kiss the boards.
controls: Q / W hips, O / P knees or hold the corner pads, Esc pause, M sound, R restart

name: Heliostat
mechanic: rotate bronze mirrors and split one dawn sunbeam so it threads every crystal in the chamber
theme: a mountain observatory's mirror gallery at midsummer dawn
tagline: Walk the morning sun where it is wanted.
controls: mouse / touch

name: Inkfall
mechanic: drag a chain through neighbouring letter tiles to spell dictionary words - every step spends ink, every banked word refills it, and the inkwell dries on its own unless you keep hunting
theme: a lamplit scriveners desk clearing three folio pages of commissions before the ink runs dry
tagline: Every word buys another drop.
controls: mouse / touch drag to spell; type letters + Enter, Backspace undoes, Esc pauses, R restarts from pause, M mute

name: Quiet Hours
mechanic: slip between patrolling guards' lantern vision cones, stand still in shadow pools to vanish, and channel-lift three treasures whose noise pulls the watch to investigate
theme: a grand museum's galleries after closing time, one cat burglar against three lantern-swinging watchmen
tagline: The guards see light. You wear the dark.
controls: WASD / arrows or hold the left touch pad to move, E / Space / LIFT button to lift a piece, P pause, R restart, M sound

name: Cuttle
mechanic: mix four skin pigments by eye to match a slowly drifting reef wall, holding your blend inside a shrinking tolerance while each wave ends in a grouper's sweeping gaze, with one ink jet as a panic escape
theme: a sunlit coral shelf where a cuttlefish survives passing groupers by becoming the living rock, pigment by pigment
tagline: Become the wall before the grouper looks.
controls: drag pigment sliders or keys 1-4 + arrows, Space ink jet, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Ballast
mechanic: hold the burner to climb and vent hot air to drop, riding stacked dawn wind bands that each drift at their own speed while gusts shove and thermals bloom, spending sandbag ballast for lift you cannot burn as spires and crags force altitude changes
theme: a lone aeronaut crossing the Karst pass in five legs at first light, from the headwind valley floor to a monastery meadow before the climbing sun kills the thermals
tagline: Altitude is money. Spend it on the wind.
controls: hold Space or the BURN pad (or the sky's right half) to burn, X or the VENT pad (left half) to vent, B drops ballast, P pause, R restart leg, M sound

name: The Last Man Up
mechanic: wind one lever driving twin cages coupled on a shared cable - stop level with each seam to load miners, post pump engineers down the shaft, and outrun the rising flood
theme: the last shift of a dying Victorian coal colliery as the river breaks into the old workings
tagline: One lever. Two cages. Everyone home.
controls: keyboard / touch

name: Firefly Vespers
mechanic: flash in rhythm to bend a scattered swarm's internal clocks toward your beat until the whole swamp blinks as one, while a frog hunts lonely or frantic flashers and gusts tear the unison apart
theme: a midsummer swamp at dusk where one small gold firefly must lead the night chorus through five widening nights before the fog rolls in
tagline: Flash alone and be eaten. Flash together and light the marsh.
controls: space / tap to flash, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Pond Regatta
mechanic: helm a pond yacht round the marks with tiller and sheet - bear away from the no-go zone, tack at the layline, ride the darker gust patches - while Old Bramble works the same breeze
theme: a golden-evening municipal boating lake, three laps of a triangular can course against the park champion's ancient wooden yacht
tagline: Trim to the wind. The trophy is tin, but it gleams.
controls: arrows / WASD or hold-drag to steer, up / down or TRIM / EASE pads for the sheet, P pause, R restart, M sound

name: Waterwolf
mechanic: raise and drop sluice-gate planks to shepherd storm rain down through three stepped canals, draining to the sea only while the tide ebbs - leave the sea sluice open on a flood and the ocean pours back in
theme: a windmill-kept North Sea polder holding out through a three-night autumn gale of drifting squalls, a storm surge and one overtopping spring tide
tagline: The sea knocks all night. Send the wolf home.
controls: mouse / touch tap gates or keys 1-3, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: False Chanterelle
mechanic: take each wild fungus in hand and judge it - cut for ridges, gills, pores or spines, sniff for apricot or damp meal - filling the basket before dusk while deadly lookalikes burn your bellies
theme: an autumn birch wood at last light, five dusks of gathering as the gold drains out of the sky
tagline: Some gold kills. Read the gills.
controls: mouse / touch tap a fungus then Cut / Smell / Keep / Leave buttons; arrows browse, Enter pick up, C S K L, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Ring Out
mechanic: read each changing row and strike the numbered bell ropes on the beat - every finished row swaps neighbouring bells as plain hunt carries each one home, while wrong or late pulls snuff the parish's five candles of sleep
theme: a candlelit village ringing chamber on New Year's Eve, ringing the old year out from St. Aubric's tower
tagline: Six bells, one beat. Don't wake the parish.
controls: keys 1-6 or tap the ropes, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Walkies!
mechanic: drag owners, dogs and lampposts across the park until no lead or greeting crosses another - crossings glow red until you tease the last knot apart, with fewer drags earning more paws
theme: eight knotted groups of dog walkers on a car-free Sunday morning in a small-town park
tagline: Eight tangled leads. Not one may cross.
controls: mouse / touch drag anyone, Tab + arrows nudge, U undo, R reset park, P pause, M sound

name: The Water Witcher
mechanic: walk parched fields reading a hazel rod's dip, tick-rate and sideways wrench to triangulate buried aquifers, then commit scarce £3 boreholes - wet bores pay by the litre, dry ones drink your stake
theme: a drought-cracked 1921 hop farm in five fields between a dying well and Miss Hedley's last thirty pounds
tagline: The rod knows. Trust the twitch.
controls: WASD / arrows or hold-drag to walk, space or the DRILL pad sinks a bore, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Ashglaze
mechanic: press wet clay on a spinning wheel to pull the wall out to the commissioned silhouette, dragging up to raise it while centring wobble and rationing water before each lump stiffens
theme: a hillside potter's yard throwing six commissions ahead of the dawn kiln
tagline: The wheel never waits.
controls: mouse / touch hold against the wall (outside squeezes, hollow flares) or the in/out pads, drag up or ↑↓ to raise, SPACE waters, ENTER sets aside, P pause, M sound, R new day

name: Shear Line
mechanic: slide a pick under each pin and lift it to its own hidden shear height, reading float and tick-pitch by feel, then feather torsion to shear it - pry too far and pins drop, lean on the plug too long and the clock bleeds
theme: a lamplit back-street locksmith’s bench opening five stubborn heirloom locks before the closing bell
tagline: Feel, don’t force.
controls: drag to slide & lift, hold Space or the TORSION pad to turn, arrows / WASD move & lift, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Falling Glass
mechanic: read the barometer, wind vane and sky omens each dawn to judge the day's weather, commit any share of the fishing fleet to sea, and spend one recall bell mid-morning before the Atlantic shows its hand
theme: a Cornish harbourmaster's office over six dawns, balancing an owners' quota against gales that wreck boats and bleed the widows' fund
tagline: The glass is falling. How many boats do you send?
controls: mouse / touch - click boats to ready them, buttons to sail, recall or sleep; keys 1-6, S, B, N

name: The Black Chamber
mechanic: map each cipher glyph onto its true letter by pattern and hunch - tap a glyph then a tray letter or just type, a full false reading scorches the candle wax, and scarce sealed hunches reveal single true letters while the candle burns down
theme: Sir Francis Walsingham's lamplit London spy chamber in 1586, cracking six intercepted dispatches before the conspirators slip away on the midnight tide
tagline: Every letter hides another letter.
controls: tap a glyph then a tray letter, or just type; arrows or tab move between glyphs, backspace clears, ctrl+Z undoes, esc pauses; buttons for hint, sound and new run

name: The Exchange
mechanic: patch five scarce cords between ringing hotel guests and the six exchange lines they ask for before their patience rings out, juggling busy jacks, gold-rim VIPs and red-hot urgent calls while spawn pressure climbs
theme: the manual switchboard of a 1920s seaside grand hotel on the busiest night of the season
tagline: Five cords. Six lines. Not one ring may die.
controls: mouse / touch tap a guest then a line; keys 1-8 pick, arrows + Enter move & plug, Esc puts the cord down, P pause, M sound, R new shift

name: The Manifold
mechanic: switch one shared brass air line between two working divers, holding each chest-gauge in its band while stoking the boiler, clearing kinked hoses and hauling the Cygnet's silver up before the gale breaks
theme: a Victorian salvage barge anchored over a sunk clipper as a rising gale drives a calm grey sea to breaking
tagline: One hose. Two men. Bring up the silver.
controls: keys 1 / 2 or tap the valve pads to feed a diver, space or STOKE pad fires the boiler, Q / E jiggle a hose clear, hold W or HAUL to wind up, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Cascade
mechanic: hold either hand to charge a throw and release to send it across the ring - your hands catch whatever falls into them by themselves, so the act is interleaving arcs as the stagehand feeds a growing fountain from three balls to seven
theme: closing night under the big top of Bostock & Verralli's travelling circus, from a lazy warm-up to a seven-ball grand finale under the gaslights
tagline: Three lamps. Two hands. Seven balls.
controls: hold F / J or press-and-hold a half of the ring to charge & throw that hand, Space throws the longest-held ball, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Beacon Ridge
mechanic: run a moonless ridge relaying fire between hill-fort pyres - your ember taper only drinks at a burning beacon, so every gap is a countdown while gales crouch the flames and bog pools drag at your heels, spending scarce brushwood to hold the whole chain alight at once
theme: a chalk-down ridge above a raid-wary coast on one black night, one runner linking seven watch-fires from the sea fort to the dawn gate
tagline: Fire eats fast. Outrun it.
controls: WASD / arrows or hold-drag to run, hold Space or the pad to kindle & feed, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Changeover
mechanic: run twin carbon-arc projectors on one screen - thread the standby reel while the last one plays, hit the changeover as the second cue dot reaches the gate, trim drifting arc current and mend snapped splices so the picture never dies
theme: Saturday matinees in the projection booth above a 1953 single-screen picture palace
tagline: Two projectors. One screen. The picture never dies.
controls: 1 / 2 select a projector, Q / E thread, T threads the standby, space changes over, arrows trim the arc, hold S to mend, X douse, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Last Over
mechanic: read each delivery's line, pace and seam then choose leg or off, loft or block, and time the swing to thread an adaptive ring while the straight ones eye your last two stumps
theme: a golden-evening village-green fixture where the last pair must scrape a six-ball chase home against the next village
tagline: Twelve needed. Six balls. One bat.
controls: arrows / WASD pick leg or off, hold loft or block, space or tap swings, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Talkdown
mechanic: select inbound aircraft and issue heading and altitude clearances, vectoring each onto the extended centreline for an automatic ILS landing while holding three miles or one thousand feet apart before the tanks run dry
theme: a rain-streaked 1963 approach-control cabin where one controller talks the last night flights down onto a single wet runway on a green CRT scope
tagline: Eight tired airliners. One wet runway. Your voice on the scope.
controls: tap a blip then tap the scope to vector, or Tab cycles + arrows; up/down or buttons set altitude, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Clatter
mechanic: paint runs of dominoes across a village-hall stage between boarded crates and sleeping cats, then tip the brass tile and spend three scarce puffs of breath huffing hesitant lines over until the act's gong rings
theme: a rain-streaked toy club rigging its grand finale on a village-hall stage, one wet Saturday afternoon at a time
tagline: Set it up. Knock it down.
controls: mouse / touch drag to lay & erase, TEST tips the tile, space or the HUFF pad puffs at your finger, P pause, M sound, R clear

name: Opus Tessellatum
mechanic: read the run-count tallies along every row and column to deduce which tesserae to set and which squares must stay bare - one chip in the wrong place cracks a wax seal, three cracks lose the commission
theme: a lamplit restorer's bench rebuilding five buried mosaic floors of a Roman villa before the museum opens at dawn
tagline: The counts never lie. Fill the floor.
controls: mouse / touch tap or drag, right-click voids, Set / Void pads; arrows + space / X, Z undo, H hint, P pause, M sound, R restart floor

name: Athanor
mechanic: combine two essences by drag or tap-and-transmute to grow a forty-three-node synthesis tree from the four primordials up to the philosophers stone, steered by per-essence lead counts and purchasable whisper hints
theme: a thunder-lit alchemists garret stacked with vials, retorts and one stubborn athanor furnace
tagline: Two things make a third. The Great Work is mostly guessing.
controls: mouse / touch - drag an essence onto another, or tap two then press Transmute; R restart, M sound, H help
